Briefly, 200 cells (25% KPC luciferase cancer cells and 75% CAF GFP-1 KRAB or CAF B500 NID2 KRAB) were resuspended as single cells in a 50-μl 1:1 mixture of Matrigel and HBSS, which was maintained on ice before being orthotopically injected into the pancreas of female NSG mice (day 0).
